tools.name: get_supabase_snapshot_sql
tools.description: Returns the read-only SQL for the live Supabase check and how to run it. It reads only catalog metadata (table and column names, RLS flags, policies, grants, triggers, SECURITY DEFINER functions, bucket settings), never table rows, and returns one JSON value.

findings.detail: Description of "scan_files" references sensitive artifacts (.env, env var, secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_supabase_snapshot · Private data: scan_files · Public sink: scan_files · Destructive: get_supabase_snapshot_sql.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_supabase_snapshot · Private data: scan_files · Public sink: scan_files · Destructive: get_supabase_snapshot_sql

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
